name: inprocess-wb-apb-pulp-spi-fuzz
notes: the same PULP apb_spi_master APB3 target and the same fixed sdi inputs as inprocess-obi-apb-pulp-spi-fuzz.json, now driven by one PicoRV32 Wishbone CPU; no CPU x IP code is added, only the CPU profile and the RAM image change
the RAM image starts at 0 because this CPU's own boot contract declares reset_vector 0; the entry takes the boot address from that contract and refuses an image that does not contain it
the target window is the same 4 KiB APB window at 0x40001000 as the Ibex variant

source_behavior names the same configs/behaviors/pulp_spi_eot_f5.json file; this CPU declares a 32-bit irq vector and no per-bit wiring is declared for it, so the host holds it at zero and F5 is refused by name (unsupported-f5:cpu-irq-unwired:wishbone:32-bit-irq-held-at-zero) even though the target declares its EOT source
no DMA model is declared, so F6 is refused by name (unsupported-f6:no-dma-model:APB)
the cpu and target declare 50 MHz, so assume_single_clock states that one host tick drives both models
fuzz mode: f1_program_words 4 declares a four-word straight-line F1 program in the fixed trampoline slot, and the bounded handler wait is 128 iterations
